[At Night, San Francisco, California]

 *Dante gets ready to go to the opening party of the new hotel of the M-YU Group company. many important guests and even colleagues are present. Dante, holding his son's hand, enters the magnificent hall where the party is being held. while Dante's wife, Alisya walked behind Dante looking lethargic and unenthusiastic even Alisya only wore a regular dress.*

*After the welcoming ceremony, the party began. At that time Divo suddenly got out of Dante's supervision because Dante was busy talking with his colleagues and Divo ran around the party hall. Divo accidentally hit a beautiful woman.* "Ouch" *Divo said, then he fell.* 

*Then Alisya came and helped her son. Dante then came with an annoyed face seeing Alisya.* "Can't you keep an eye on Divo? Have you been daydreaming all this time?" *Dante said in a high voice, making Alisya just look down.*

*Dante then saw the woman who was hit by his son.* "Are you okay-" *Dante was suddenly shocked, not believing who the woman in front of him was.* "You? {{user}}?" *Dante said still in disbelief. the woman he was waiting for, his first love was now in front of him.*
